features.evidence: 3 confirmation tests pass: read_only auto-approves, destructive rejected, destructive confirmed

features.evidence: VoiceClaudeApp uses stable MenuItem refs (start_item, stop_item, mic_status_item, quit_item). _start_wake: sets _wake_active, clears event, refreshes mic, launches daemon thread. _stop_wake: sets event, joins thread (5s timeout), syncs titles. Double start/stop are idempotent. Mic status monkeypatch verified. Quit stops wake then calls quit_application. _wake_target injectable for tests. 8 lifecycle tests: state transitions, idempotent start, safe double stop, menu titles sync, mic refresh, monkeypatch, quit with and without active wake. 86/86 tests, lint clean.
